subject: Activate additive anti-overengineering gate; product evidence before new control-plane machinery
body: User-directed internal process improvement. ANTI_OVERENGINEERING_GATE_V1 is additive/reversible and introduces no daemon, heartbeat, background loop, new authority edge, or production-write capability. New global coordination mechanisms default to reject/bounded experiment unless tied to a concrete observed failure, evidence, failed existing primitives, cheaper-alternative comparison, measurable benefit, rollback, and sunset. Current 30s durable service cadence is flagged for simplification review but is not silently superseded. Human-gated single-writer production commit boundary remains unchanged.
